entries: {SOMEONE:!plural} came to {place} {MANNER} bearing {THING}, and asked for {first}.
{DISASTER:strikes} fell on {place}, and the {rival} named {first} the cause.
{first} found {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, bound with an old ward.
The ward over {landmark} failed, and {SOMEONE} crawled out {MANNER}.
The {rival} called {place} to war {DEADLINE}, and {first} was named in the muster.
